reviews.title: Smh. Hope yall see this.
reviews.body: So I’ve been using the app for a while now, and this has to be the worst update I’ve ever SEEN on this app. Back then, the ads weren’t even that bad. In fact, it’s actually tolerable. But these pieces I’ll NEVER get used too. Despite having the daily log in, it’s still bad. And there were a few nights that I’ve noticed that Chai would glitch out and tell you that the plus option was free, while the ultra isn’t. Me personally I think we should have three options. One option for having normal chats, another for plus, and one for ultra. So those who wish to spend their money can, while the people who thinks this update is TERRIBLE can have their original freedom back. But even if we can’t have three options, then remove the pieces. I’ve noticed a lot of complaints ever since this update happened, and I hope you all see this one.
